state.seed_assertion: Maintenance logs should record information at the point of work while data is available rather than reconstructing details from memory later.

sentences.1: Maintenance logs should record information at the point of work while data is available rather than reconstructing details from memory later.
sentences.2: Record the event where the work happens Capture the date, meter, work, person, cost, and evidence while the information is available.
sentences.3: A brief complete entry made at the asset is more useful than a detailed entry reconstructed from memory a month later.
sentences.4: A good maintenance log entry includes specific asset ID, date, work type, exact parts replaced, failure details, downtime duration, and technician name.
sentences.5: This information helps when similar problems occur later and provides training material for other engineers.
sentences.6: An equipment maintenance log serves as the institutional memory of a plant, with each entry either adding to the record of what an asset has experienced or creating a gap that will incur costs later.
sentences.7: Did the motor stop suddenly or slow down gradually? Was there unusual noise? Did anything smell hot? These observable details point toward causes that logs and alarms cannot reveal.
